items.headline: Draft Omnibus IX would ban benzophenone-1 and -2
items.summary: Notified 8 Jul 2026. CMR-based bans start 1 Feb 2027; SCCS-based bans follow after 12 to 24 month transitions.

items.headline: FDA adds bemotrizinol to the sunscreen monograph
items.summary: Up to 6% for ages 6 months and older, effective 9 Aug 2026, with 18 months of exclusivity for the requester.

items.headline: CDSCO: injectables are not cosmetics
items.summary: Public notice of 18 May 2026 restates the cosmetic definition and bars treatment claims.
